name: E. Pellicci
summary: A family-run Italian café on Bethnal Green Road, established in 1900. Its early-1940s interior has Grade II listed status.

story.opened: 1900, as a family-run Italian café; the Pellicci family still runs it.
story.then: Priamo Pellicci's widow, Elide, kept the café going after his death in 1931 while bringing up seven children. Carpenter Achille Capocci was commissioned to fit the Deco-style panelled interior. Nevio Pellicci ran the business until 2008, and his wife Maria now heads it. The café was listed Grade II in 2005.
story.now: Every dish is on offer all day, from breakfasts to pancakes. It serves coffee, holds an alcohol licence, and runs a cocktail night on the first Thursday of each month.
story.vibe: Time Out describes it as fitted out with Formica, with friendly staff who like a chat. The café's own page stresses its ornate wooden panelling.
worth_knowing: The Krays were regulars, according to a 2005 Londonist report.
Harry Styles filmed a little of the 'Late Night Talking' video here in 2022, says Time Out.
The chrome 'E' on the shopfront is for Elide Pellicci, whose portrait hangs inside.
Listing describes it as a rare intact example of a stylish Italian café.
